items.title: Lunar horizon illustration
items.generate: Landscape 16:9 framed illustration for a restrained lunar documentary. Distinctly hand-painted editorial gouache on textured paper, not a historical photo or a photoreal rendering. Vast empty surface of the Moon viewed at ground level, silvery powdered regolith and one understated astronaut bootprint in the middle foreground, low undulating mountains and an ink-black sky beyond, a small blue Earth hanging above the right third. Desaturated charcoal and pale silver, subtle cold blue accent, late raking sunlight from the left. Broad, uncluttered composition; keep the Earth and bootprint within the middle 70 percent vertically for a widescreen crop. Rich detail in the powdered soil but quiet overall. No people, machines, flags, lettering or logos.
